name: wrap-off
description: A text return arrow interrupted by a diagonal slash.
useCase: Turn off automatic wrapping of long lines in a text editor.
misuse: Use a label to state the affected control and whether it is disabled or unavailable.

16.reason: Deliberate openings around the full diagonal slash preserve the identifying parts at text size.

24.reason: The full slash and separate functional parts keep the disabled state clear within the square frame.
